CONFIGURATION MISMATCH (model year and trim): Car and Driver's instrumented test of a 2018 Honda Odyssey with the 10-speed automatic, which the summary said was the Elite trim, republished on Yahoo Autos. Same 3.5L V6, 10-speed automatic and front drive as the 2024 EX-L, but it predates the 2021 refresh, and the Elite rides on 19-inch tyres (235/55 R19 per Honda's 2024 sheet for Sport/Touring/Elite) and is heavier and better equipped than the EX-L.
